notes:
{和紙|わし} is traditional Japanese handmade paper, prized for its beauty, durability, and versatility. Made from plant fibers such as {楮|こうぞ} (mulberry), {三椏|みつまた} (mitsumata), and {雁皮|がんぴ} (gampi).

CHARACTERISTICS:
- Stronger and more durable than machine-made paper
- Translucent, with natural texture
- UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage (since 2014)

COMMON USES:
- {障子|しょうじ}: sliding paper screens
- {書道|しょどう}: calligraphy
- {折|お}り{紙|がみ}: origami
- {提灯|ちょうちん}: paper lanterns

CONTRAST:
- {和紙|わし}: Japanese paper ({和|わ} = Japanese)
- {洋紙|ようし}: Western-style paper ({洋|よう} = Western)
